comments.text: The worst part of this is you can use apps now to compare insurance, but when you use those they quote you with low prices then when you try to buy one they quote goes up $50 - $60. I almost never use my car insurance, almost never have an accident, I shouldn't be paying $150 - $200 for freaking car insurance that I am never gonna use. Car insurance is bullshit....
